issues.quote: Revenue fell to $94.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $118.9 billion in fiscal 2024, a decline of 2.9%.
issues.problem: Tesla's FY2024 revenue was about $97.7 billion, not $118.9 billion. The 2.9% decline matches $97.7B. A drop from $118.9B would be about 20%.

data.summary: Most figures are right, but FY2024 revenue is misstated as $118.9B when it was about $97.7B. That number doesn't fit the 2.9% decline the analysis itself gives.
